display_title: 没有怪物受到伤害的TD No Creeps Were Harmed TD

reviews.text: With this and Axon TD coming out, I hope the Tower Defense genre is going to have a renaissance. I'm tired of throwing darts at bloons. This game is a fresh new take on the genre and it's a wild ride.

关注了一段时间。没有想象中那么惊艳，但好评还是勉强值得的。 游戏主打一个三维立体塔防，但是三维的部分给人感觉并不好。玩家很少因三维地形的互动而获得优势，反而很多塔会被三维物体卡视野，并且霰弹塔和远程塔这种直线穿透的塔，因为高度差的原因，就算在一条直线上也很容易穿透不到全部的怪。三维给人感觉唯一的优势就是射程能覆盖更多路径，但除了地震塔和冰冻塔这类全范围AOE的之外没有任何意义，而路径可以修墙改动，唯一的优势也显得无关紧要了。另外，三维体验最独特的双面地图和立方体地图要后期才能解锁…… 抛开对三维部分的小失望，这游戏作为一个塔防来说还算合格。美术不错，内容足够，该有的都有，包括局外成长和联机，完成度蛮高的。音乐和剧情有点搞，不过不影响可玩性。但仅凭这些扎实的基础，从众多优秀的塔防中是无法脱颖而出的。再加上价格贵，就显得十分平庸了。
好玩，防御阵型的精神继承者，还加入了基友同乐模式，必须好评啊！
The algorithm demands SACRIFICE, I shall deliver
地图设计新颖，可以双人合作，非常好玩，但是少了一点肉鸽元素，我提个建议，比如你的塔可以升级三四个选项，但是别设置每个选项的升级上线，这样子可以更有个性。
太肝了，很多关要刷神器和高等级，给什么神器还看脸。

目前来说游戏体验其实并算特别好，但也有不少亮点，未来可期。 3D路径的塔防确实是第一次玩到，可以有更复杂的路径和空间规划。但是缺点也很明显，炮塔在功能上并没有太多对针对3D的特征进行设计。如果能修改部分炮塔，能让他们在3D空间中有更好的特色表现，这将是一个好游戏。 游戏更新还是挺勤快的。 优点： 1、3D地图给走线布局带来了一个独特且不一样的体验。 2、部分怪物设计不错，需要玩家多设计弯路来应对，丰富了布局的多样性，比较有意思。 3、自爆农场好用，不是它给我赚了多少钱，而是它的自爆能有效处理大量强力怪物。 4、哪怕防御失败了也会给经验和神器。 5、虽然神器掉落有一定随机性，但是前期关卡不依赖神器质量，肝无尽或在后期关卡里反复失败也可以掉好神器。 缺点： 1、炮塔卡俯仰角。和白色实验室相似，虽然可以造在墙上来缓解俯仰角，但一旦炮塔密集起来，造有弹道的炮塔就基本都是负收益了。我建议可以让炮塔能建造在墙壁的侧面，这样可以增加玩家对地形的改造能力，也可以加强3D空间里炮塔对地形的适应能力。 2、没有伤害计数器，需要在关卡内（或者关卡结束时），能够查看到每个炮塔对敌人造成的伤害计数。
很好玩的塔防游戏，单人玩起来如同打手冲，组队玩如同开淫趴。 感觉有几个不足吧，有的塔等级上限太低了，感觉后期都没用。 还有就是地图难度跨度比较大吧，能不能来点地形很好的爽图和早日开创意工坊。 制作者们加油！
做了那么多张地图，但是想不明白为什么那么多人连10个小时都玩不到？
已退款，如果你有地图编辑器，和创意工坊，我会入3份，一份给我2份分享给朋友

This could be the greatest desktop tower defense there is. But its not. I am fine with basically everything except that the creeps attack the towers and disable them. There is no fun or challenge in that. Its simply stupid and i dont see any reason to have this in the game. I am willing to pay more money and money for more DLCs since its a REALLY great game. But not at this point. Please make a setting to deactivate that my towers can be attacked.
总体上一般的塔防作品 而且很多地图算是强制要两个人玩 一个人玩纯折磨 有搭子还行
UI简直是灾难，前端该换人了。
一个让玩家不爽的游戏，整体难度太难，又没有引导，

Bad balance for a while now. Way too hard and rewards for clearing earlier hard maps are laughable. It was fun and I would have recommended it after the first week of playing but then after that the devs made some questionable decisions and now I don't feel the need to play anymore since the game doesn't reward me for my time put in or the difficulty i'm on. Basically you get the really really good items if you play the hardest maps on the hardest difficulty alone... SO WHERE WOULD YOU WANT TO USE IT THEN IN THE FUTURE??? On the first map ??? Makes no sense.
首先就是翻译的问题，机器翻译的问题太严重了，很多东西都写得不清楚，然后就是数值的问题一，炮台的升级所需要的数值太多了可而击败怪物所带来的数值并不能支持尽快升级，就导致要等许多波次之后才能升级炮塔，而那个时候升级的炮塔已经午饭战胜怪物。

很喜欢这个游戏，作者加油！我相信有需要改进的地方作者都能逐渐改善，目前就是感觉神器存储位置太少了，塔的种类很多，集齐神器需要很多存储空间，50个存储空间显然不够。Like this game very much, the author refueling! I believe that the author can gradually improve the areas that need improvement. At present, I feel that there are too few storage places for artifacts. There are many types of towers, and a lot of storage space is needed to collect all artifacts.

Its fun and it is different. That being said I expected a bit more from the pictures and videos. Would not buy it for second time. My biggest issue with the game is the creeps, the enemy. Their design is kind of weird and behaviour unpredictable, unsorted, it just often becomes one big mess and it is hard to orient yourself in what enemy types are out there and which kind of gun is the right one for those. It is hard for me to distinguish even the basic types of enemy units and I have no favourite unit at all, they all look weird, dark and filthy. There are also outright absurd kinds of enemies like some lightspeed bugs who teleport directly to the next obstacle. In perfect TD games like Defense Grid or Fieldrunners, or in others very well done like the gratuitous series, anomaly and or Sanctum, in each of these titles the designers made big effort to make enemy units as clearly distinguishable and iconic as possible. Those units also do look at least a bit sympathetic, at least some of them. Or they look strong or have other qualities, that can be perceived positively. I believe there is a good reason for all of that. It is a shame, because on the other side of No creeps were harmed TD: the guns are fun, the Brian and his story is not quite bad (despite terrible voice acting probaly done at home in the shower using some stock mic) and the levels design is advanced and interesting. I feel there is enough value in the game for the money, just the creeps design kills the fun for me.

【好评少点】 感受：算及格的塔防，还没到很好玩经典的程度。 > 3D地形有点不适应，转来转去 > 能联机，没试过 > 已经满级解锁所有炮塔 > 炮塔虽多，一局也就用一两种 > 炮塔强度需要把地图高分通关获得神器，但上限最多3个 > 地图虽然大，基本一两个炮塔就完事，再加上强化塔堆叠 > 一两个炮塔因为：升级炮塔价格会越来越贵 > 一两个炮塔因为：3D地形炮塔相连会阻碍视野 > 地图虽多，地形不大限制略多，不爽 > 神器太多影响寻找，分类筛选功能不友好 > UI 有点丑，字体居中一长一短，看着难受 > UI 界面东西略多，看着不清爽 2024年1月30日 --------------------------------------------------------------------------

This has potential to be a very good tower defense game but it's not quite there yet. I find the artifact system to be quite confusing and some of the artifacts especially at the beginning seem to do almost nothing at all. I haven't put but just over 6 hours into the game so far but. I find that porters are getting through to my base and I don't even know how they are doing it let alone how to stop them. The tower upgrade system is pretty good, maybe a little expensive for the amount of credits that you get. The artifacts just mess with my head though, and the limit of three artifacts doesn't make a lot of sense either. This game has been compared to Defense Grid so I'm going to take that a little further. Simplicity needs to be the name of the game folks one of the attractive things about tower defense is that it's not complicated. The closest thing to artifacts in Defense Grid was in Defense Grid 2 where you could give the towers special abilities like causing the machine gun bullets to strip away shields more easily and the like. You would unlock maybe two or three of the abilities per tower as the game progressed. This was easy to deal with easy to add on and it wasn't limited to jut three well basically measly abilities across all of your towers. I think the artifact system need to be revamped and simplified. I recommend the game but the artifact system is kind of a headache right now and it's waaaay to limited. Good game, good start but do something with the artifact system. Plus do something to make what porters are doing at least noticeable I was on level three I think and I had no way that i could even see how they were getting through.
通关简单，打无尽到了一定波数怪像死了马一样炸塔，各种堆血。钱太少，升级只能升级几个塔
希望开发者能看到，游戏很简单，直接用第一个塔就完成最高难度的所有地图了，比较简单。但是玩无尽模式的时候，怪兽血量叠的太快，而且全是那种boss怪，关键所有的地图后面的无尽怪都差不多，血量叠的太快了，不像第一个版本一样可以打到100+关卡，没啥意思，现在所有地图都是60关左右就打不过了，千篇一律，说实话没啥意思

[h1]《富有创造力的惩罚机制》[/h1] 玩还是能玩的，折后价钱勉强能接受，但是这个特别好评明显是过誉了，这两天看列表又是买又是愿望单的感觉里面有点坑，提醒我好友悠着点。 这游戏里面的大部分机制基本上都被其他塔防玩烂了：摆路径，英雄能打人之类的。这一套体系的设计还算合理。 然后我们看看创新了什么： [h3]1. 防御塔需要吃维持费[/h3]，而且是按收入百分比吃。正儿八经的惩罚机制，且不谈它的后期影响，刚开局就要求你用最少的塔获得最高的效能，不然就算苟过去也会慢性死亡，这意味着你需要一定程度上背一下某关卡的敌人配置，它关卡之间敌人配兵还不太一样。 那问题来了，你喜欢背敌人类型和新敌人加入的波次吗？如果你喜欢，你可能需要去玩Arkights。如果不，那气球塔防5还真就是这类游戏最优解。为了最小化你背东西的难受程度和最大化策略深度，气球塔防所有地图里敌人的顺序是一样的。直接根据地图特性思考即刻，不需要背敌人。 那既然说到地图了： [h3]2. 三维游戏地图[/h3] 大多数塔防都是个平面地图，而几乎所有塔防重力都是朝下的。这款游戏的确在这一点上做出了突破。 但是然后呢？ 你知道弯道边上防御塔覆盖路径最长，你也知道如果他头顶有路径还能更长一点。你知道障碍物会阻挡射击视野，你也知道三维空间里也是这样。 除了地图变得花里胡哨和视角移动更麻烦，更不容易纵观全局了以外，没找到什么游戏性上的突破在里面。这又算个惩罚机制。 [h3]3. 多路径地图设计[/h3] 我一直都坚定的认为，在塔防游戏里设计大于一条路径，且每条路径上的障碍物分布和出兵雷同的行为纯属傻逼 你给我个复制粘贴键吧，谁闲得无聊给几个一样的路上面多加水水多加面啊，而且拜您这地图所赐我一眼还看不全，[h3]您又想掐着我的脖子让我骗个好友来联机是吗[/h3] 而这个游戏就是八倍的傻逼，他除了能搞两条差不多的路+每条路上两个对称出兵点以外，还能给你出“两条路上的这种怪靠近时融合强化”这种烂活儿。 除此之外还经常有两条进攻路线方向相反，然后两条路上垂直于直达路线互相连接的神秘操作导致路径规划让强迫症及其难受。举个例子，地图是“目”字形，一条路左上到左下，一条右下到右上。虽然给你提供了四条横向通路来提高路径总长度，但路径的利用率只有一半。 [h3]4. 塔和怪的不平衡对抗[/h3] 首先有多种怪能打你的塔（范围自爆，范围抛射攻击，射击时减速以蹲在怪群后面，射线直射以稳定攻击医疗无人机） 其次塔没有“最高攻击威胁”的优先级选项 这意味着无论你如何设计塔的配置，它都会在某个时候被物理意义上的干穿。而你的修复手段在这种进攻体系下杯水车薪。这种失败原因不知道为什么反正我觉得很恼火。你都不让我打他，除非我在第一条防线上的火力过剩到把怪全都干死！？ 是的是的，创新是惩罚性的这件事本身可能不是一个问题，就像不允许我按一个红按钮就直接赢得游戏也是一种惩罚。 我不喜欢的是他这个惩罚并不提供新的挑战形式，而是让本身已经反复玩过的塔防流程变得令人难受了 就像给你布置作业“编写python程序打印数字1到10000但是只准写print不准写for和while”一样
作为一个3D游戏，炮塔的射程居然不是根据射弹的物理来决定的，而是一个固定的球形。早在上个世纪的rts游戏里就有高地优势的概念了啊，这里居然没有😡

For about 8 hours i tried to like the game but in the end i just couldnt do that. Its a bit sad in a way that there arent that many good tower defense games in my opinion. And the game has good base for a good game but at this time for me the game is just frustrating and i am not having fun when i play it. Negatives: - Enemies attack towers and can destroy them (I can understand why its in the game but i dont have to like it) - User Interface/User experience, needs too many clicks to do things and the way towers are at of writing its too much of a mess to pick up your towers (for example no icons to faster recognize what you are selecting and there just are too many towers crammed in to a list) - I feel that making mazes isnt that easy and you are punished for putting too many towers (you get less money the more towers you put on the map) Positives: + Graphics are nice + I like the voice acting and ERROR and Brian Jar (would be nice tho that Brian didnt repeat that much) + The game has a lot of towers + Multiple maps and you arent forced to play them in the right order (of course first maps are easier vs last maps) +/- Artifacts are interesting/can be interesting but those that i have gotten havent been that good or interesting. They also arent mandatory (by the dev) which is good of course. I had a feeling that maybe the developer has played Defense Grid (one of the best tower defense games imho) because i kinda got familiar feeling when playing the first maps. For me i will be waiting for more updates and maybe returning to the game at a later date because at the moment i have no reason to play the game.

Well, I got to a point with No Creeps were harmed that I threw in the towel. There is so much here to like - the story is weird, dark and self-aware. I wish I could have struggled through to the end to hear how it ends. The 3d aspect of pathing and platforms has some very creative maps. Much of the time the map is littered with “junk” or “scaffolds” that you have to clear / rebuild to make the tile available. So you have this huge canvas that needs a bit of work to get to a path you want. What I thought was a plus - so many towers, is actually a hard negative. For one, it’s nearly impossible to see any affect any tower is having on any one creep, so you have to rely on the descriptions that the towers are actually doing what they say they are going to do, but with so many creeps, so many guns, and ammunition flowing, it’s nigh impossible to see if a tower is doing any good or not. Also the creeps nearly disappear with very little contrast between them & the background. And that’s kind of what brought the game down for me. It’s a difficult game - I was playing on medium, with the intent to unlock everything and then come back on hard, but one of the primary items for tower defense - leaking, is and I quote the developer who answered me on their forums: The “kill every creep” objective is going to be the hardest thing to get on every map. I suggest maybe going after these last, and just get yourself a good set of artifacts that work with your play style before trying to get 100% on all the maps. And I just could not mentally handle the hundreds of creeps leaking. It just doesn’t feel like progress at all. This was on a later map - somewhere along 7 or 8 I think when i threw in the towel. Earlier maps, I had little issue in getting this achievement, and it wasn’t until map 6 (Relay) where I had a leak and 5 or so tries wasn’t working and I went to the forums and go the above answer. It may be me, but I use leaks as an indicator whether what I’m doing is working, and to get the “3 stars” you need to stop the leak, but on the last map where I gave up, it was just too many and the number of towers you have unlocked (15-20 I think?) is just too many for me to play whack-a-mole with so threw in the towel. It’s early access, but I have little faith the dev is going to change their ways.
游戏性挺好有创意，UI太屎了，部分塔数值和无尽模式的强度递增有点怪，期待制作组进一步优化

Minmaxing feels like needing to push the "Rush Wave" Button every few seconds while also needing to pause every 1-2 seconds to upgrade a tower. Just too much clicking & pausing. Also there is no autopause between the waves which makes it hard to keep track on which wave you are/overlook that the next wave has started. This was basicly the dealbreaker for me. UI isn't well arranged (Like left should be right, up should be down, its exactly the opposite and idk why but it just feels wrong) and has a bad overview. The bent maps feel weird to navigate and keep a good overview, altough i absolutely understand the gameplay mechanics with this, just another thing that is simply unpleasant to deal with even if it makes sense for the gameplay. Else the game seems to be good, didn't play too long as you can see.
为什么镜头不能像所有建模软件那样，可以让人自由调整？ 锁镜头角度是你的核心设计理念吗？ 此外WASD也很奇怪，镜头将根据固定向量进行移动，在任意镜头旋转后，它的移动将变得“不可控”。

Love the game but please add an extra confirmation button when going to reset. Had a nice endless build going then wanted to go into my settings and my dumbass accidentally restarted the entire run, that was not very cash money :/

Great tower defense game, I would even argue one of the best. Up until the cloaker was introduced, it just completely ruins the game. And just like every other TD game, the developer haven't taken note. Game goes from being fun and chill on easier modes to just change from one level to another to be completely ridiculous with more enemies than you can handle. Forget about bonus objectives...
It looks like a solid td. I really like the verticality of some of the maps
Not what I would do but okay.

希望UI得到如下的改进，当前的UI过于抽象了： 1.UI字体可以进一步放大，且把多数UI居中，例如在主菜单和设置菜单等地方UI的位置过于反常，再如在剧情对话中相对于对话框而言字体又过于小了。 2.UI设计应尽量准寻简洁，直观的设计原则，如菜单等应尽量有效运用整个屏幕，游戏内的菜单等也应尽量简洁明了一些，如在1080P的分辨率下多数数值（如炮塔升级菜单所显示的升级费用等）过于贴近屏幕边缘，不符合UI设计简洁明了的设计理念。

Steam2024塔防游戏节上发现的，推荐塔防玩家在折扣时入手！ 系统特点： 1，3D化的地图关卡设计，除了地形遮挡之外，塔的攻击视野会被自己其他塔遮挡（开始没注意这个），路线规划有一定的自由度，而且越到后期关卡越变态或者说脑洞越大，挑战性极强； 2，有个布莱恩的角色设计，即是游戏中各种塔的建造者，也有点类似英雄单位的意思（攻击力有点弱，我主要拿来反隐），还可以施放一些技能（核弹、黑洞、区域修复，增益等）； 3，塔的数量和收益挂钩，塔越多收益越少，配合路线上的自由度设计，到底是摆位更多的塔还是精心计算升级，需要玩家自己仔细权衡利弊； 4，每个塔都可以升级各种属性，更重要的是塔可以多选，可以批量升级，甚至还有一个右键自动升级队列设计（如果没钱建新塔，可以暂停自动升级队列这个花钱大户，建好新塔后再开启自动队列），熟练后使用后可以更多的思考布局和塔的攻击策略设计，大大减少了手忙脚乱的情况（我游戏玩的少，好像没见过其他塔防游戏里有自动升级队列设计的）； 4，塔可以被怪物打爆，虽然每到新的波开始会自动修复，或者可以立刻使用修复技能或修理无人机等，但总体上游戏中后期也不能轻松，需要时刻关注局部地区战况； 5，有一个神器系统，类似装备卡槽，可以搭配对应的塔使用，可以强化塔或让塔获得新能力。其获得方式主要靠关卡评分和抽卡，不过前期低分数时，能用的都上就好了，后期可能坐牢的点主要在于抽到想要的神器，以及神器升级需要的点数上。 总体玩下来，有一种玩星际争霸2的TD mod的感觉！也算是最近几年少有的传统塔防精品了，且自带中文，TD塔防爱好者可以入手了。 不确定有无创意工坊，正在攻略关卡中，如果有那就太好了，如果没有请考虑增加steam的创意工坊； ——以上是10小时左右游戏评价，下面是最新评价 —— 目前来说： 1，请考虑增加steam的创意工坊，主要是更多关卡； 2，请官方考虑更新神器系统，神器在游戏后期感觉很不爽，它需要靠运气抽取，又不能全部使用，还需要神器点升级，你们自己看看，这就3类限制了。 你们还不如痛快的全部展示出来，让玩家自己选择购买，然后用神器点数一路升级上去，然后随着等级提升，可以装备更多神器，比如开始3个，后面增加到9个等等。 后期关卡虽然越变态，但是玩家可以装备神器越多等级越来越高，起码还是匹配的，而且成长体系的提升也是最直观的。

[h1]近年来少有的塔防精品游戏！[/h1] 《没有怪物受到伤害的TD》是由MinMax Games Ltd.自研自发的一款相当少见的3D立体科幻类策略塔防游戏，游戏里玩家莫名其妙的只剩下个大脑，还是在培育仓里能自由行动的那种，陪伴着的辅助机器人也是相当的不靠谱，并且都成这样了竟然还要在众多怪兽的进攻下努力工作！为了保护好自己的脑子！设计路线、建设各种炮塔击败所有来犯的怪兽吧！ 游戏的画面设计相当不错，科技感十足，怪兽巢穴制作的也足够恶心，整个场景空间都是立体的，不是简单可旋转的那种立体，而是有着上下左右四面八方的那种立体，你能想象你的炮塔能横着建在半空向下攻击么？就是这种立体！怎么样？是不是闻所未闻？这里就有！不过建设的时候得千万留意，这种立体空间是有视野阻挡的，建设防御塔的时候需要千万留意上下高低关系，哪怕是同排同样高度，也是存在遮挡关系的！这样的设计对玩家的策略布塔要求极高！ 游戏里的防御塔种类相当丰富，攻击机制各不相同，还有着各种各样的属性包括攻击、攻速、范围等等都能升级，在建设防御塔的时候有时候会让怪物改变行军路线，换个话说也就是我们可以通过建设来影响怪兽的行进路线，这里又更是增加了许多策略性，不过防御塔都有血量，需要小心被怪物打爆（或者被自己的远程炮攻击到），除了这点还得留意建设防御塔不能太多，因为防御塔数量是和收益挂钩的，数量越多，打怪获得的“信用点”就越少，这滚雪球效应到后期会很难受！ 另外游戏还有“神器系统”，但是只能对应相应的防御塔，属于那种可以给相应防御塔加特殊属性或者改变攻击方式的那种，相当有用。结合游戏可以自由自在规划建设路线和搭建防御塔种类的特性，在塔防游戏里整一出构筑在战斗BD，也算是相当有想法也相当新颖了！ 按目前的游戏内容来说，《没有怪物受到伤害的TD》除了名字稍微奇怪了点，剧情也稍微单薄无厘头了一点之外，游戏的美工、建模和玩法算是近年来少有的塔防精品游戏了，在这个塔防游戏逐渐式微的年代，能遇到这样的游戏很是难得，塔防爱好者们不用考虑太多了哦！ [table] [tr] [th]游戏由SteamPY鉴赏家提供[/th] [/tr] [tr] [td]SteamPY鉴赏家[/td] [/tr] [tr] [td][h3]上SteamPY淘海量超低价游戏[/h3][/td] [/tr] [/table]

狗屎一样的惩罚机制，和魔兽争霸一样的维护费，塔防游戏防御塔之间会相互阻挡攻击范围。还有我看开发者回答别人的话，什么叫防御塔可以建造在任何地方，所以给出了合理的限制？狗屎。这游戏又不是真的能凭空建造防御塔，还是必须要建造在地块上的，你的防御塔再怎么能有一个三维的攻击范围，没地方给你建造，或者别的防御塔给你挡住了，你的防御塔实际的攻击范围，甚至比一般的2D塔防游戏的范围还要小。 维护费这种惩罚机制，制作者是没带脑子吗？塔防游戏本来就是享受越来越多的塔，以此来获得爽感的游戏，你这个维护费是真的逆天，你真要觉得这是给玩家的挑战，建议改成一个能开关的挑战选项。现在这种情况就是，塔建造的少了打不过，塔建造多了升不起塔，后期高额的升级费用，以及大量防御塔带来的维护费，使得这游戏变成了两头恶心。 纯纯的恶心玩家，又是开发者一拍脑门的设计。别的塔防游戏，玩家都是绞尽脑汁怎么样将地图上铺满防御塔，你倒好，防御塔下的越多惩罚越严重，关键是还有防御塔之间互相卡攻击范围，这两个惩罚机制相辅相成一同构成了构史！

On the plus side, this is tower defense, with lots of tower options, and I love tower defense! On the minus side... essentially everything else. The UI is clunky, making gameplay a lot more frustrating than it ought to be, and the "story" aspects--the personalization of the "Brian Jar" protagonist, and the little skits when moving from location to location--are awkward at best and poorly voiced. The "artifact" system is also awkward and IMO doesn't really contribute well to gameplay. I should be EAGER to grind for new artifacts, and instead I'm like UGH it's going to make me select from one of three different weird things AGAIN? I have to sell all but three of them repeatedly to try to amass "credit" to upgrade the very rare one that seems useful HOW many times before amassing enough credit? The actual upgrade is HOW miniscule...? Ugh. I gave this game a couple of hours and got bored with it, then decided to give it another chance with another six. That total of eight hours is plenty; I don't see me returning to it.

This is one of those games I wish I could put a neutral vote for. Ultimately, its meh, and I wouldn't recommend it to a friend. Honestly, it just isn't my cup of tea. The good is outweighed by the bad. The game itself is sound. No bugs, or issues of a technical nature. Runs smooth as a whistle. Music and voice acting is horrendous. Gameplay. Well, while it was initially fun and gave a good sense you were working towards something with each level, the unlocked traps were just... underwhelming. Don't get me wrong, they were a nice change of pace and allow you to mix up your strategy for each map. Problem is, they well, suck. Take the chain bolter, for example. 200% damage to shielded targets is great. Until you read the fine print where it inflicts between 1 and max damage. Eh? Honestly, I stopped using it immediately after I got it in favour of the cheaper beam emitters. Another example? The final thing you unlock at level 18 is a quantum farm which increases creds received at the end of each wave. Upgrade it, get more creds. Sounds good on paper, buts its extortionate to upgrade to the point its just pointless. By time you can afford to upgrade it to make use of it, the kills net you far more than the farm ever would, plus the amount you've put into it would've been better spent in trap upgrades to rush the wave. There's possibly an argument to be made that you could build all 10 cap of them, upkeep be damned and rely on it for income but you'd have to do the maths on that. Personally don't see it working out, but I've been wrong before. You can probably go through them all and only find 5 or 6 useful ones. Chrono ray and Ranger turret could be useful if you could limit their firing angle... Ground Pounder needs a massive dps boost or range doubled. Lag field needs to have a 1 title variant. Laser Fence, see chain bolter. I think you get my point. My biggest gripe with the game is the fact your traps can be damaged. Sure, your second power unlock is a repair tool that relies on Pow to use but it's not enough. Not even close. As soon as boss monsters begin spawning, and even with health upgrades on your traps, you are constantly with destroyed towers you can do nothing about. Its not until level 16 (I think?) you get the medic hub to alleviate this issue and its another upkeep tax hog with drones that are easily destroyed even with max health upgrades. I've tried everything I could think of to combat around this issue but line of sight prevents getting around it. Your traps need it, these creatures don't. They are walking artillery platforms that explode on death damaging everything around them. If there's a way to mitigate their destructive potential on your death maze, I've not found it. My partial solution is to split my death zones into three parts so the damage is more spread out. It's not a solution though. Yes I'm playing on hard which likely explains all of this, but everything needs a counter and the counter cannot be 200 medic hubs. I'm also not a fan of more than two thirds of the maps I've played. This is less to do with the layout, but the creep limit and the subsequent mutation mechanic that kicks in. Solving the puzzle of the layout is more of a chore than the fun I had in say, defense grid. I suspect my dislike of the levels though is more coloured by my dislike of the tools. I've more to say but this review is looking a little long in the tooth so I stop it here.
The game is exhausting to play. The maps are overly complicated, and are too large. The resources to build mazes are expensive and limited. There is so much to keep track of for a tower defense game.

After completing the game I can say that I never really liked it. The main cause is the presence of elements that make it overly complicated without increasing its depth. These include the presence of hatching eggs, an exaggerated amount of power-ups, artifacts, and above all, I do not like being penalized for building new towers. Using towers to create new paths in your favor is one of the most rewarding things (as in Defense Grid), and the idea of limiting them is bad.

Great towerdefense with a bit of a funny weird story. Offering a lot of tactical options and a unique twist on resource-management by each structure costing upkeep, reducing your income and emphasizing a balance of upgrading, mazing and building.

It's a competent TD game with good aesthetics and such, however ultimately you will spend a lot of time watching sped-up creeps just getting flayed without much else happening. Then eventually an Endless Mode wave will walk through your maze like it's nothing, seemingly escalating the difficulty instantly. So it's difficult to get a feel for just how your setup is performing and special effects like poison, flame, slowdown etc don't make very much of a visual or behavioural difference to provide an interesting spectacle. But then I personally am the sort who generally dislikes grid based, number heavy TD games - as opposed to the whacky ballistic/physics/player input that a TD game like Toy Soldiers has.

Other negative reviews have pointed out the problems so there's no need for depth. - There's really no tower to influence the economy. Later there is a farm, but basically it's useless and takes up too much real estate - Constant damage being done to your towers is irritating - Taxing the player for mazing with towers is nonsense. Sure, you can build cheap walls to maze, but now tower LOS is hindered. Why are you punishing the player for building more towers? It's . . . a tower defense game. Good lord. Dev is like, "Here's my tower defense game . . . now ration your towers." - Later maps are complicated. Only determined autists will spend the time to figure out the build order - Artifacts, or "tower boosts" are apparently limited to 3 total, and if I understand it correctly, only work 10% of the time? I can't find a screen where I can see the artifact in the tower. Is it auto-slotted? Who knows. Is there an artifact I can eventually get where the tower awards +20% credits on kill? That's the only artifact I'm interested in. All this damage being done to my towers and not enough money coming in to build . . . wouldn't matter anyway since the more I build, the more I'm taxed. Whatever. - Difficulty setting "Medium" must be a funny joke Dev could seriously shave off 25% of the towers available, implement a tower that influences the economy by receiving bonus credits for kills within a perimeter like Defense Grid, and have a game that is more fun. There is a reason Defense Grid is still GOAT . . . and no TD dev apparently has any idea as to why. Unreal. Here's to hoping someone via WeMod will make this game fun.

Underrated masterpiece of a tower defense. This is the ONLY tower defense I've seen that does the "your towers can die" mechanic but actually fair and balanced. The towers and enemies are also mechanically interesting and fun to interact with without being too gimmicky. Also, the game isn't balanced around an economy tower. This is HUGE as the tower defense genre has been dominated by banana farms ever since they were invented. There is one economy tower, but its painfully underpowered. The developers were probably scared of it being too good, and that's for a good reason.
